name: vibefoundry-toolkit
description: Ask questions about public data, build data apps that follow VibeFoundry's conventions, and open the file viewer pane with one approval.

interface.shortDescription: Turn data into applications, with a local file viewer
interface.longDescription: VibeFoundry answers questions about the data in a hub and computes the exact structure a data application should have. A local pane shows your project's files and the plan as a chart; sign in to your company's hub from it to use private tables. Nothing about your project leaves your machine.
